description.value: Dollar Max is a discount variety retail store located in Richmond, BC, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a department store. Shops of this type typically stock a mix of household goods, seasonal items, and basic packaged foods at low price points. It could serve as a convenient supply stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.
